period: StratEx ground testing before October 2014 balloon flights
protocol: One suited pilot in a manned pressure-profile run at the Arizona State University Del E. Webb Altitude Chamber. The authors report execution of the approved oxygen prebreathe protocol. Actual oxygen delivery history and actual elapsed prebreathe are unavailable.
outcome_window: During and after the test as reported. Duration of post-test observation unavailable.

protocol: Same pilot on the three crewed stratospheric balloon flights documented by Lee et al. and Leidich et al. The flight program describes four hours of planned oxygen prebreathe. The medical report describes 100% oxygen and a nominal suit pressure differential of 5.4 psi. Actual gas and pressure histories are unavailable.
outcome_window: Retrospective report across the project. No standard postflight DCS surveillance window or individual clinical assessments reported.
